question.text:
Suppose we run Dijkstra's single-source shortest path algorithm on the following edge-weighted directed graph with vertex $\mathbf{S}$ as the source. (Assume alphabetical order for tie-breaking).

  1. $S, U, Q, R, T, P$
     
  2. $S, R, Q, U, T, P$
     
  3. $S, Q, R, U, T, P$
     
  4. $S, R, U, Q, T, P$
